full_text_zh:
[P1] NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC KIDS
美国国家地理探索世界双语小百科
Frogs
青蛙
[美] 玛菲·弗格森·德拉诺 著
卢嘉宁 译
浙江少年儿童出版社·杭州
Boulder Publishing
大石精品图书

[P2] 看,一只青蛙!
Look, a frog!
在树上,一只小小的树蛙正抱着一根细细的树枝保持平衡。树蛙轻轻地在树枝上走,又一下子跳到树叶上。它的脚尖黏黏的,能帮助它在很多地方爬上爬下。
Up in a tree, a tiny tree frog balances on a branch. Tree frogs tiptoe on twigs and leap onto leaves. Sticky toe tips help tree frogs climb and cling.

[P3] 小溪旁，一只大牛蛙正窝在湿湿软软的烂泥里。吧唧！真舒服哇！
Down by a stream, a big bullfrog snuggles into squishy, mushy mud. Squelch!
沙漠里，一只锄足蟾正在挖洞。它的后腿就像铲子一样，挖起洞来可厉害了！
In a sandy desert, a spadefoot toad digs with shovel-like back feet, burrowing underground.

[P4] 扑通！
Sploosh!
池塘里，一只长腿豹蛙从睡莲叶子上一跃而起。它在空中拱起身子，扑通一声跳进水里，溅起一阵水花。
Out in a pond, a leggy leopard frog launches off a lily pad. It arches through the air and splashes into the water.

[P5] 南美角蛙
生活在南美洲
青蛙的家
Home, sweet home
锄足蟾
生活在北美洲
除了南极以外，地球上几乎任何地方都可以看到青蛙——山顶上、森林里、小溪河流边、池塘湖泊里、田野上、公园里、花园里，还有沙漠里，到处都是青蛙的家！
Frogs live almost everywhere on Earth, except Antarctica.
You can find them on mountaintops, in forests, creeks and rivers, ponds and lakes, fields, parks, gardens, and deserts.
全世界一共有5000多种青蛙，这里是其中的几种，一起来认识一下吧！
There are more than 5,000 kinds of frogs.
Here are some from around the world.
火焰箭毒蛙
生活在中美洲和南美洲
华莱士飞蛙
生活在东南亚
越南苔藓蛙
生活在东南亚
弗莱施曼玻璃蛙
生活在中美洲
澳大利亚绿树蛙
生活在大洋洲

[P6] 青蛙有许多不同的颜色，
大小也不一样。有的青蛙很小，有的很大。
Frogs come in many different
colors and sizes. They can be
tiny or they can be huge.
有的青蛙皮肤很粗糙，身上疙疙瘩瘩的；有的却很光滑；还有些青蛙的皮肤是透明的！
Frogs can be bumpy, or frogs can be smooth.
Some frogs are even see-through!

[P7] 青蛙宝宝出来了！
Pop!
卵孵化后，青蛙宝宝——小蝌蚪从里面
游出来。蝌蚪生活在水里，吃水里微小的植物。它们看起来很像鱼，其实是扭来扭去的
青蛙宝宝。
When the eggs hatch, out pop tiny tadpoles.
They live underwater and eat tiny plants. They
look like fish, but they are wiggly, wiggly baby
frogs, also known as pollywogs.
大多数青蛙妈妈都在水里或
水边产卵。
Most mother frogs lay eggs in or
near water.

[P8] 小蝌蚪刚出生的时候，
身体圆圆胖胖、粗粗短短
的，尾巴长长的、扁扁的。
等它长大一些，它的身体就
会发生奇妙的变化。看，它
长出腿来了，腿可以帮助它
游来游去、跳上跳下！
Tadpoles start out with
chubby, stubby bodies and
long, flat tails. But as a
tadpole grows, its body
changes. It sprouts legs
for swimming and
hopping.
它的尾巴越来越短，眼睛越来越鼓，嘴巴越来
越宽。
Its tail gets smaller and smaller. Its eyes get bulg-
ier and bulgier. Its mouth gets wider and wider.
终于，它长成了一只青蛙，可以爬上岸了！
Finally the tadpole looks like a frog.
Out of the water it crawls.

[P9] 现在，小青蛙开始探索新世界啦——先吃个虫子吧！
Now the young frog is ready to explore its new world—and to eat!
好美味！
Gulp!
青蛙最爱吃虫子了。当它看到虫子飞过时，会飞快地伸出又长又黏的舌头粘住虫子，再收回舌头，整个吞下去。
This frog loves to eat bugs. It shoots out its sticky tongue to snap up a passing insect, pulls the prey into its mouth, and swallows it whole.

[P10] 青蛙的食物
Froggy Feasts
你的舌头可以伸多长？
青蛙一点儿也不挑食。只要自己的大嘴巴能塞得下，几乎任何会动的东西它们都吃！
Frogs are not fussy eaters. They will eat just about anything that moves, as long as it can fit into their mouths.
对青蛙来说，小虫子、毛毛虫可美味了！
你觉得虫子好吃吗？会是什么味道？
青蛙吃昆虫、蜘蛛、蠕虫、鼻涕虫，还有蜗牛。有些个头大的青蛙还会吃老鼠，甚至是其他青蛙！
Frogs chow down on insects, spiders, worms, slugs, and snails. Some large frogs also dine on mice, and even other frogs!
你想不想中午吃蜥蜴，晚上吃蜘蛛？
这只青蛙刚抓到了一只美味的蜻蜓。
小老鼠，当心！青蛙可能要吃你！

[P11] 青蛙不挑食，而它们同样也是
很多动物的食物。
Frogs eat all kinds of animals, and
all kinds of animals eat frogs!
鸟儿、蝙蝠、蛇、老鼠、浣熊、鱼、
蜥蜴、鳄鱼以及熊，都喜欢吃青蛙。
Birds and bats, snakes and rats, raccoons,
fish, lizards, crocodiles, and even bears all
gobble up frogs.

[P12] 青蛙怎样保护自己呢？
How do frogs survive?
有些青蛙躲在跟自己体色相近的环境里，
把自己藏起来。有些青蛙颜色鲜艳，它们以此
来警告饥饿的捕食者：“别吃我！”这些色彩鲜艳
的青蛙的皮肤是有毒的。
Some hide by blending into the background.
Some have brilliant colors that warn hungry
hunters, “Don’t eat me!” These brightly hued
frogs have poison in their skin.

[P13] 跳起来, 青蛙!
Jump, frog!
青蛙在地面上遇到危险时, 会飞快地跳开。有的青蛙还能大大地张开脚趾, 从树枝上“飞”下来。平安着陆!
A frog on the ground can leap to safety.
And in a treetop, a gliding frog spreads its toes wide, jumps off a branch, and glides.
Happy landing!

[P14] 青蛙和蟾蜍
Frog & toad
皮肤湿湿的、滑滑的。
你的皮肤摸起来是什么感觉呢？
没有尾巴。
腿又长又有力，跳起来可厉害了。你能像青蛙那样跳吗？
后腿有5根脚趾。
青蛙
眼睛鼓鼓的。
有牙齿。
前腿有4根脚趾。
青蛙喜欢生活在水边，而蟾蜍喜欢待在较为干燥的地方，甚至是沙漠里。下面列举了一些它们之间的相同和不同之处，快来看看吧！
Frogs live most of their lives around water. Toads can be found in drier places, even in deserts! Here are some ways that frogs and toads are different—and the same.
皮肤干干的，身上疙疙瘩瘩的。还有什么东西摸起来也是疙疙瘩瘩的呢？
没有尾巴。
腿短短的，只能走路或短距离跳跃。
蟾蜍
眼睛后面能产生有毒的汁液。
没有牙齿。
前腿有4根脚趾。你有几根手指、几根脚趾呢？
后腿有5根脚趾。

[P15] 学青蛙唱歌！
Sing Like a Frog!
有时候，你看不到青蛙，
却听得见青蛙在唱歌。有些青蛙会把喉咙鼓得像一个气球一样，发出响亮的歌声。每种青蛙都有它独特的歌声。有些青蛙嗓门很大，你隔得很远都可以听到它的歌声。这里是几种青蛙的歌声，你能发出这些声音吗？
Even when you can't see frogs,
you can often hear them singing. Some frogs puff up their throats like balloons to make sound. Each type of frog has its own special call. Some are so loud they can be heard a mile away! Here are some frog calls. Can you make these froggy sounds?
呃！呃！呃！
牛蛙
嘎！嘎！嘎！
春雨蛙
嘎！嘎！嘎！
红眼树蛙
考——齐！
老齐蛙
唧哦！
灰树蛙
呱！呱！呱！
林蛙
full_text_en:
[P1] NATIONAL GEOGRAPHIC KIDS
National Geographic Explore the World Bilingual Encyclopedia
Frogs
Frogs
[USA] Mafe Ferguson Delano, Author
Lu Jiani, Translator
Zhejiang Children's Publishing House · Hangzhou
Boulder Publishing
Boulder Premium Books

[P2] Look, a frog!
Look, a frog!
Up in a tree, a tiny tree frog balances on a branch. Tree frogs tiptoe on twigs and leap onto leaves. Sticky toe tips help tree frogs climb and cling.
Up in a tree, a tiny tree frog balances on a branch. Tree frogs tiptoe on twigs and leap onto leaves. Sticky toe tips help tree frogs climb and cling.

[P3] By a stream, a big bullfrog snuggles into squishy, mushy mud. Squelch!
In a sandy desert, a spadefoot toad digs with shovel-like back feet, burrowing underground.

[P4] Splish!
Sploosh!
In a pond, a leggy leopard frog leaps from a lily pad. It arches its body in the air, splashing into the water with a 'plop' and creating a splash.
Out in a pond, a leggy leopard frog launches off a lily pad. It arches through the air and splashes into the water.

[P5] South American horned frog
Lives in South America
Frogs' Home
Home, sweet home
Spadefoot toad
Lives in North America
Except for Antarctica, frogs can be found almost anywhere on Earth—on mountaintops, in forests, by creeks and rivers, in ponds and lakes, in fields, parks, gardens, and even deserts! They are everywhere!
Frogs live almost everywhere on Earth, except Antarctica.
You can find them on mountaintops, in forests, creeks and rivers, ponds and lakes, fields, parks, gardens, and deserts.
There are more than 5,000 kinds of frogs in the world. Here are a few examples from around the globe.
Fire-bellied poison dart frog
Lives in Central and South America
Wallace's flying frog
Lives in Southeast Asia
Vietnamese moss frog
Lives in Southeast Asia
Fleischmann's glass frog
Lives in Central America
Australian green tree frog
Lives in Oceania

[P6] Frogs come in many different colors and sizes. They can be tiny or they can be huge.
Frogs can be bumpy, or frogs can be smooth. Some frogs are even see-through!

[P7] Frog Babies Are Here!
Pop!
After the eggs hatch, frog babies—tiny tadpoles—emerge from inside. Tadpoles live underwater and eat tiny plants. They look like fish, but they are wiggly, wiggly baby frogs.
When the eggs hatch, out pop tiny tadpoles. They live underwater and eat tiny plants. They look like fish, but they are wiggly, wiggly baby frogs, also known as pollywogs.
Most mother frogs lay eggs in or near water.

[P8] When a tadpole is born,
its body is chubby and stubby,
with a long, flat tail.
As it grows, its body changes.
Look, it's growing legs!
Legs help it swim and hop.
Tadpoles start out with
chubby, stubby bodies and
long, flat tails. But as a
tadpole grows, its body
changes. It sprouts legs
for swimming and
hopping.
Its tail gets smaller and smaller. Its eyes get bulg-
ier and bulgier. Its mouth gets wider and wider.
Finally, it grows into a frog that can crawl onto land!
Finally the tadpole looks like a frog.
Out of the water it crawls.

[P9] Now, the young frog is ready to explore its new world—first, let's eat a bug!
Now the young frog is ready to explore its new world—and to eat!
Delicious!
Gulp!
The frog loves to eat bugs. When it sees an insect flying by, it quickly shoots out its long, sticky tongue to catch the bug, pulls it into its mouth, and swallows it whole.
This frog loves to eat bugs. It shoots out its sticky tongue to snap up a passing insect, pulls the prey into its mouth, and swallows it whole.

[P10] Froggy Feasts
How long can your tongue stretch?
Frogs are not fussy eaters. They will eat just about anything that moves, as long as it can fit into their mouths.
For frogs, little bugs and caterpillars are delicious!
Do you think bugs taste good? What do you think they taste like?
Frogs chow down on insects, spiders, worms, slugs, and snails. Some large frogs also dine on mice, and even other frogs!
Want to eat a lizard for lunch and a spider for dinner?
This frog just caught a tasty dragonfly.
Little mouse, watch out! A frog might eat you!

[P11] Frogs are not picky eaters, and they are also
food for many animals.
Frogs eat all kinds of animals, and
all kinds of animals eat frogs!
Birds, bats, snakes, rats, raccoons,
fish, lizards, crocodiles, and even bears all
love to eat frogs.
Birds and bats, snakes and rats, raccoons,
fish, lizards, crocodiles, and even bears all
gobble up frogs.

[P12] How do frogs protect themselves?
How do frogs survive?
Some frogs hide in environments that match their body color,
hiding themselves. Some frogs have bright colors, which they use
to warn hungry predators: “Don’t eat me!” These brightly colored
frogs have poison in their skin.
Some hide by blending into the background.
Some have brilliant colors that warn hungry
hunters, “Don’t eat me!” These brightly hued
frogs have poison in their skin.

[P13] Jump, frog!
Jump, frog!
A frog on the ground can leap to safety. And in a treetop, a gliding frog spreads its toes wide, jumps off a branch, and glides. Happy landing!
A frog on the ground can leap to safety. And in a treetop, a gliding frog spreads its toes wide, jumps off a branch, and glides. Happy landing!

[P14] Frog & toad
Skin is wet and slippery.
What does your skin feel like?
No tail.
Legs are long and strong, jumping is powerful. Can you jump like a frog?
Back legs have 5 toes.
Frog
Eyes are bulging.
Has teeth.
Front legs have 4 toes.
Frogs live most of their lives around water. Toads can be found in drier places, even in deserts! Here are some ways that frogs and toads are different—and the same.
Skin is dry and bumpy. What else feels bumpy?
No tail.
Legs are short, can only walk or hop short distances.
Toad
Behind the eyes can produce toxic juice.
No teeth.
Front legs have 4 toes. How many fingers and toes do you have?
Back legs have 5 toes.

[P15] Sing Like a Frog!
Sometimes you can't see frogs, but you can often hear them singing. Some frogs puff up their throats like balloons to make loud sounds. Each type of frog has its own special call. Some are so loud they can be heard a mile away! Here are some frog calls. Can you make these froggy sounds?
Croak! Croak! Croak!
Bullfrog
Grrr! Grrr! Grrr!
Spring Peeper
Grrr! Grrr! Grrr!
Red-eyed Tree Frog
Ko—chi!
Old Chie Frog
Ji-oh!
Gray Tree Frog
Gua! Gua! Gua!
Wood Frog
full_summary_zh:
[P1] 本页为绘本《青蛙》的封面，展示了一只绿色青蛙攀附在植物茎上的特写照片，并标注了书名、作者、译者及出版社信息。
[P2] 本页展示了一只树蛙攀附在树枝上的照片，并配有中英文文字说明，介绍树蛙如何用黏性的脚尖在树枝和树叶间保持平衡、行走和跳跃。
[P3] 本页通过左右两幅照片分别展示了大牛蛙在溪边烂泥中栖息和锄足蟾在沙漠中用后腿挖洞的场景，并配有中英文说明文字。
[P4] 本页展示了一只长腿豹蛙从睡莲叶上跃入池塘的瞬间，配有中英文文字说明其跳跃动作和溅起水花的场景。
[P5] 本页以“青蛙的家”为主题，介绍了青蛙在全球的广泛分布，并展示了来自不同地区的多种青蛙，包括南美角蛙、锄足蟾、火焰箭毒蛙、华莱士飞蛙、越南苔藓蛙、弗莱施曼玻璃蛙和澳大利亚绿树蛙，每种青蛙都配有图片和其生活区域的说明。
[P6] 本页通过左右两栏图文介绍了青蛙的多样性，左侧展示了一只色彩鲜艳的箭毒蛙，说明青蛙颜色和大小各异；右侧展示了皮肤粗糙的蟾蜍和透明皮肤的玻璃蛙，说明青蛙皮肤质地也各不相同。
[P7] 本页介绍了青蛙的繁殖过程，说明大多数青蛙妈妈在水里或水边产卵，卵孵化后小蝌蚪（青蛙宝宝）游出来，生活在水中并以微小植物为食。
[P8] 本页展示了小蝌蚪从出生到长成青蛙的变态发育过程，左侧图片为长出后腿的蝌蚪，右侧图片为即将成年的青蛙，配有中英文说明其身体变化。
[P9] 本页展示了小青蛙开始探索世界并捕食昆虫的场景，通过左右两栏图文说明了青蛙用长而黏的舌头捕捉并吞食虫子的过程。
[P10] 本页介绍了青蛙的饮食习惯，说明它们不挑食，会吃各种会动的小动物，包括昆虫、蜘蛛、蠕虫、蜗牛，甚至老鼠和其他青蛙，并通过图片和文字展示了青蛙捕食的场景。
[P11] 本页通过图文说明青蛙是许多动物的食物，列举了鸟类、蝙蝠、蛇、老鼠、浣熊、鱼、蜥蜴、鳄鱼和熊等捕食青蛙的动物，强调了青蛙在食物链中的位置。
[P12] 本页介绍了青蛙的自我保护方式，包括通过体色伪装隐藏自己，或通过鲜艳色彩警告捕食者其皮肤有毒。
[P13] 本页展示了青蛙在遇到危险时的逃生方式，包括在地面跳跃和在树顶张开脚趾滑翔，并配有中英文说明。
[P14] 本页通过图文对比介绍了青蛙和蟾蜍的异同，包括生活环境、皮肤特征、肢体结构和生理特点，帮助读者区分这两种两栖动物。
[P15] 本页介绍了不同种类青蛙的叫声，通过图文展示牛蛙、春雨蛙、红眼树蛙、老齐蛙、灰树蛙和林蛙等青蛙在鸣叫时鼓起喉咙的形态，并配以拟声词，引导读者模仿青蛙的叫声。
